ios.desc:
Marriage Card Game is a popular 21-card variant of rummy card game. This Taas game can be played even without internet, from anywhere, anytime!

We have recently also added Voice Chat Feature.
Enjoy marriage card games through social features like Hotspot, Multiplayer and Private Table, you can now play this classic rummy variant online or offline.

Also spelled/known as:
- merija / merij / mericha game
- taas / tash game 
- म्यारिज
- myarij 21
- Nepali taas marriage
- marriage games
- marrige
- 21 Marriage Card Game

KEY FEATURES
- Voice Chat to talk while you play with your friends.
- Single Player with fun bots like Gabbar & Mogambo.
- Hotspot Mode with near and dear ones.
- Multiplayer to compete for leaderboard rankings.
- Fully Customizable Gameplay.
- Cool Themes including Nepali, Indian & Bollywood. 
- Center Collection Point Calculator

We have various modes for you!!!
- Fun bots like Pataka, Gabbar, Momolisa and VadaTau are here to make the single-player experience fun.
- In Multiplayer mode, challenge the players all around the world, and secure top spot in the leaderboard. 
- In Hotspot/Private Mode, play and talk with your friends and family from anywhere, anytime! 


More Features: 
-Voice Chat with Family- 
You can talk with your friends and family while playing Marriage Card Game, no matter how far you are. 

-Customizable Game Modes - 
You can customize your Gameplay and set what best works for you and your pals. 

- Multiple Tables with Different Boot Amounts -
You can gradually unlock tables of higher stakes which keeps the fun and excitement going.

- Challenging and Fun Bots - 
Yeti, Gabbar, and Pataka are some of the bots you will meet in the game. They will make you feel as though you were playing with real people.

- Badges and Achievements -
Show off your game achievements to your friends through Badges and User Statistics.

- Claim Gifts - 
You can also claim gifts on hourly basis, and give a headstart to your gameplay. 

- Center Collection - 
Play offline with friends and family and calculate points using this app, because we know it is very tiring to calculate points using pen and paper. 

HOW TO PLAY MARRIAGE RUMMY
Number of cards: 3 decks of 52 cards
Option to Add up to 3 Man Cards and 1 Superman Card
Variations: Murder and Kidnap
Number of players: 2-5
Playing Time: 4-5 minutes per game

Game Objectives
The prime objective of the game is to arrange twenty-one cards into valid sets.

Terms
Tiplu: Same suit and rank as the jok

quotes.text:
We developed a card game on React Native almost a year back. We were initially developing the game using cordova but were taken by the performance issues. We switched on to React Native and were very much impressed with the performance. One year since we released the game, we are working on the next version and we have decided to stick with React Native. The development is much faster and easier. We very much liked the native animation support that has since been available with React Native. The only problem we faced was with admob integration. No regrets so far.

iOS app: https://itunes.apple.com/us/app/marriage-card-game/id1161818616?mt=8

Android app: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.bhoos.marriage

Note: It was our very first attempt on mobile gaming. The rules for the games are available here if anybody is interested to learn https://www.pagat.com/rummy/marriage.html The game is meant for players who already know the game rules.
quotes.story_title: Ask HN: Companies who adopted React Native over a year ago, do you regret it?
